CustomField.label: Value
CustomField.description: The comparison value. For most operators a literal (e.g. Closed, 100); for Relative Date the number paired with the Relative Function (e.g. 60 with N_DAYS_AGO); for In a comma-separated list.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Literal value, comma-separated list for In, or the N for a Relative Function.
